            # Don't expand further from this node since we want exactly this depth

def bfs_exact_depth(graph, start, target_depth):
    """Find nodes whose shortest path distance from start is exactly target_depth."""
    queue = deque([start])
    distances = {start: 0}
    
    while queue:
        node = queue.popleft()
        current_dist = distances[node]
